critical_notes: Not a verified event dataset: candidate URLs, timestamps and price series require independent checking.
Do not confuse first worldwide authorization with first FDA authorization.
Efficacy percentages are announcement claims and must be interpreted in their study context.
Safety reports and causality determinations must be distinguished.
Never transmit event summary, event label or hindsight to the blind analyst before cutoff.
Use adjusted prices and contemporaneous benchmark, calculate market/sector-adjusted returns; control for other announcements.
